assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE transparent mascot sprite of chibi Ado (Japanese singer's navy-haired anime avatar), guided closely by the attached cursor-theme REFERENCE IMAGE for proportions and graphic style only. Ignore all cursor symbols, lettering, panels and screenshot UI. This should look like a funny cute Ado reaction sticker / tiny anime desktop pet, NOT a polished tall anime doll. Proportions are essential: SUPER DEFORMED, only 1.6 heads tall in total, enormous round head about 63% of full character height, very short bean-shaped torso, stubby mitten hands, tiny feet. Long midnight navy hair forms a compact rounded mass around the tiny body, chunky simple bangs and a single curved ahoge; keep hair within the squat silhouette, not long flowing strands. Big turquoise eyes can deform dramatically for expression. Small black oversized coat-dress, simple white collar/cuffs, small turquoise bow/brooch, black tiny shoes. Thick soft dark-navy outlines, clean simple 2D cel colors, only one subtle shadow tone, broad shapes legible at 64px. NO detailed rendering, NO glossy hair, NO realistic fingers, NO adult proportions, NO ornate clothing, NO white sticker border. EXPRESSION/POSE: hilariously cute grumpy pout, puffed rosy cheeks, very lowered angled eyebrows, squinty turquoise eyes, tiny inverted-V mouth, both tiny fists clenched at her sides inside oversized sleeves, shoulders scrunched up and one tiny foot stomping. Playfully indignant and harmless, like 'hmph!', irresistibly silly rather than genuinely threatening. Add one small navy comic anger vein above her bangs, NO words. Full entire character visible, centered in square canvas with 12% transparent padding all around. Genuine transparent alpha, no ground, no shadow underneath, no checkerboard, no cursor, no text.
